answer_1.quote: We train and evaluate ASR and ST models on MuST-C v1.0, which contains parallel speech-to-text data with English (en) as source language and 8 target text languages, namely Dutch (nl), French (fr), German (de), Italian (it), Portuguese (pt), Romanian (ro), Russian (ru), and Spanish (es).
answer_1.outputs: Speech transcripts for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and translated text for speech-to-text translation (ST)

answer_2.quote: Evaluation is performed on the tst-COMMON, by computing word error rate (WER) for ASR and BLEU with SacreBLEU (Post, 2018) for ST.
